$comment: The only place model ids live. Everything else reads them from here (Terraform, the agent image, the web app for the labels). agentModel is the default model for clip jobs; clipModels lists, in display order, the models the owner may pick for clip jobs in Settings › Clip making › AI model (the clipModel setting, docs/CONTRACTS.md §5 and docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-42), each with a label and one plain line for that screen. A model's own profilePrefix overrides the top-level one (Haiku for Ask Clip Factory and Nova 2 Lite, the second watcher of the deep analysis, use the EU geo profile, docs/CONTRACTS.md §19.5 and docs/DECISIONS.md ADR-40); profileRegions lists that profile's destination regions, for IAM. embeddingModel.modelId is in-Region and used as is (never prefixed with profilePrefix). askModel and askFallbackModel are Ask's models (docs/CONTRACTS.md §27.1, ADR-50): Claude in Amazon Bedrock (the bedrock-mantle Messages API) in-Region at askEndpoint.region, so their bare modelId is used (no profile prefix); opus-4-8 is Ask's refusal fallback only and is not in clipModels.

opus-4-8.label: Claude Opus 4.8
opus-4-8.line: Ask's backup when Opus 5.5 says no.
